title: AgentOutputEvent
description: Bounded neutral agent output event for streaming assistant text. AS31 contract v2 — no tool details, no thought/reasoning, no arbitrary metadata.

contract-version.description: Contract schema version for agent output events

turn-id.description: Canonical turn ID within the session

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the turn, or null. Must be strictly increasing when present.

kind.description: Bounded closed-set output kind (Stage 1: text only)

text.description: Assistant text content. Bounded to 64 KiB per fragment (UTF-8 bytes).

observed-at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the output was observed

is-final.description: True if this is the final fragment for the turn (ASSISTANT_FINAL kind)
